name: U.S. Department of Energy, Integrated Energy Systems Office (formerly Solar Energy Technologies Office)
collect_note: Reads the Open and Upcoming Funding Opportunities lists on the DOE solar funding page and keeps notices whose title names workforce or apprenticeship; the program's own page is a completed selection list with no open call, so a new solar workforce notice would appear here as a candidate. The same listing feeds the SETO row, which keeps agrivoltaics titles, so the two filters do not overlap on one call.

zero_reason.quote: There are no upcoming funding opportunities at this time.
zero_reason.note: Open list holds only the Space Photovoltaics Research and Development Partnership Intermediary Agreement and the Tribal Energy Capacity Expansion (TECE) Prize, neither workforce; the filter was tested against the program's own title, 'Advancing Workforce Partnerships Funding Program', which it matches.

evidence: Plain HTTP GET energy.gov/eere/solar/advancing-equity-through-workforce-partnerships-funding-program HTTP 200 (server-rendered selectee list, updated May 11, 2026, no eligibility or deadline text).
